headline: Foreign Portfolio Investors Inject Record Rs 84,291 Crore into Indian Equities
summary: Foreign investors directed a record Rs 84,291 crore ($10.1 billion) into Indian equity markets during the first half of November, with more than half allocated to financial and banking stocks.
why: Foreign portfolio inflows dictate emerging market liquidity, local index performance, and currency strength, signaling shifting capital allocations away from East Asian tech markets.

impacts.name: BSE SENSEX
impacts.why: Record overseas buying provided strong support to Indian benchmark equity indices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global fund reallocation out of North Asian technology stocks led to record foreign buying in Indian banking and financial equities.
